rule: D-025 (docs/M4_WP3_WORKING_CORPUS_STAGE2_GUIDANCE_RULING.md, evidence check 6). Per arm, in the order fire_weather_v1 then extreme_heat_v1: (1) start from the frozen place-candidate list; (2) sort ascending by LIT2 id (code-point order of the 'LIT2-NNNNNN' string); (3) remove later members of exact-byte duplicate groups (same SHA-256 within the arm) for sampling only, recording each suppression; (4) assign ranks 1..N; (5) select ranks 10,20,...,100 (fire_weather_v1) and 14,28,...,140 (extreme_heat_v1). If a selected rank does not exist after suppression, or is already used, advance to the next higher unused rank. If an item selected for extreme_heat_v1 is already in the fire_weather_v1 sample, keep it in fire_weather_v1 and advance extreme_heat_v1 to the next higher unused rank. Exactly 10 unique items per arm; 20 distinct items overall. No manual replacement; no file is opened.
